landingWelcome.title: Explore conservation planning options for Colombia.
landingWelcome.description: This decision-support tool helps compare precomputed conservation scenarios across Colombia. Use it to see how different biodiversity targets, included areas, and cost assumptions change the places highlighted for conservation action.
landingWelcome.decisionSupportNote: The scenarios are intended to inform discussion and planning; they do not replace local expertise, policy review, or final conservation decisions.

steps.selectSolution: Click Select solution to open the guided scenario finder.
steps.exploreMap: Choose conservation priorities and review the matching scenario on the map.
steps.reviewAnalysis: Use the side panels to inspect layers, metrics, and tradeoffs.

finder.selectionSummaryPattern: {{targets}} target selections, {{variables}} variable includes/excludes, {{tradeoff}} trade-off basis

stepIntros.step1: Select one or more target groups for what to protect. For each selected target, choose a coverage level (17% or 30%).
stepIntros.step2a: Choose optional included areas to apply alongside the always-on RUNAP protected areas.
stepIntros.step2b: Choose a cost layer to evaluate potential conservation areas.
stepIntros.step3: Matching scenarios refresh automatically as you change filters.

helpers.constraints: Choose optional included areas after you finish Step 1.
helpers.results: Results refresh automatically when targets and trade-off basis are chosen.

locked.constraints: Complete Step 1 to unlock includes, excludes, and trade-off options.
locked.results: Choose targets and trade-off basis to automatically see matching results.

step1.targetTypeIntro: Select one or more target groups for what to protect. For each selected target, choose a coverage level (17% or 30%).
step1.ecosystemsHelp: Aims to include the full range of Colombia’s different ecosystem types in conservation planning.
step1.speciesRichnessHelp: Gives priority to places with the greatest number of different species.
step1.strategicEcosystemsHelp: Focuses on a specific subset of ecosystem types that are nationally designated as strategic (paramos, mangroves, wetlands, and tropical dry forest), rather than the full range of ecosystem types.
step1.ecosystemServicesHelp: Covers benefits people receive from nature, such as water regulation, flood buffering, and pollination.
step1.otherNaturalCulturalElementsHelp: Covers additional priorities such as sacred or culturally important landscapes and traditional use areas.
step1.targetLevelRequiredHint: Select one or more target types. Each selected target also needs a coverage level (17% or 30%) before Step 2 unlocks.
step1.selectLevelToContinue: Select 17% or 30% to complete this target.
step1.summarySelectTarget: Select one or more target types to continue.
step1.summaryNeedsLevel: {{selected}} selected · {{remaining}} still need a coverage level.
step1.lockReasonSelectTargetType: Choose at least one target type to continue.
step1.lockReasonSelectTargetLevel: Choose 17% or 30% for each selected target type.
step1.targetLevelIntro: National representation goal as a percent target (17% or 30%).
step1.strategicLevelFixed: 30% — only level available for strategic ecosystems in the current catalog.

step2a.includeOmecsHelp: OMECs (WDPA/WDOECM “other effective conservation measures”) are optional; scenario filenames include +OMEC when on.
step2a.includeComunidadesHelp: Locks in Afro-Colombian community territories alongside RUNAP when enabled.
step2a.includeResguardosHelp: Locks in Indigenous reserve territories alongside RUNAP when enabled.
step2a.alwaysRunapHelp: National protected-area network (RUNAP) is included in every precomputed scenario in this catalog.

step2b.intro: Choose a cost layer to evaluate potential conservation areas.
step2b.humanFootprintHelp: Shows projected human footprint intensity to provide pressure context across the landscape.
step2b.carbonOpportunityHelp: Monetary net-benefit / agricultural-rent surface (CO, Renta_agropecuaria in filenames).

empty.title: Set filters to view a scenario

results.scenarioCarbonShield: Prioritizes carbon density while excluding mining pressure and urban edge zones.
